questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: CUHK will suit someone who is desperate for knowledge and organized teamwork. Hong Kong is a fabulous place to let us experience how cultural diversity and island sights throughout many means.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Official Websites will guide us clearly, and the tutor who supports the exchange program will help us effectively.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Not so much. Most works are done by myself, and I asked for help from both offices from CUHK and KU, which are partly helpful.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: KUnet is a complex website including mass information without clear hits. It would be not so efficient for someone to find the information they would. And the reactions from KU actually will take 2-3days to response to our questions. I would suggest all things you want to know and want to figure out should be done advanced!!!

questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: You can pay for three meals, or just go to the canteen to eat. It's easy for us to choose.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Taxi and on-campus are the only transportation at CUHK. Not so many supermarkets nearby the CUHK because CUHK actually lies on a hill and hosts away to the downtown.

questions.answer: Pretty easy if you can show the ability that you can pass the exam and have related knowledge background for specific subjects.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do know the transferring credit rules then choose your courses, or it would be so difficult to change your pre-approval courses between KU and CUHK. Because KU reacts so slowly while the CUHK conduct everything so quickly.
